description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'CsrfUtil' responsible for handling Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection mechanisms within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages CSRF tokens for both AJAX and non-AJAX requests, including token generation, validation, cache management, and URL modification to embed tokens.

classes.name: CsrfUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for CSRF token management, including generation, validation, associating tokens with sessions, URL modification, and cache management within the OFBiz security module.

methods.name: getTokenMap
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CSRF token map associated with the session and specific party and context, supporting cache size limits.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a new CSRF token using the configured defense strategy.

methods.name: getRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Reduces the request URI to a certain number of subfolders as defined by the strategy to limit token scope.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the request URI from a given path or request URI string, removing query parameters, control paths, and fragments.

methods.name: generateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for non-AJAX requests, storing it in session or cache as needed.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Locates the request mapping configuration for a given URL within the web application configuration.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Overloaded method that finds a request map from a map of request maps and a URL path segment.

methods.name: generateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for AJAX requests, stored in session.

methods.name: getTokenForAjax
methods.description: Returns the CSRF token stored in session for AJAX requests.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Embeds or updates a CSRF token parameter in a URL.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Embeds or updates a CSRF token parameter within a query string URL.

methods.name: checkToken
methods.description: Validates the CSRF token for a request, throwing an exception if invalid or missing.

methods.name: cleanupTokenMap
methods.description: Removes the context-specific CSRF tokens from the session cache associated with a given user session.

methods.name: getTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Returns the configured token parameter name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: setTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Sets the token parameter name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: getStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current CSRF defense strategy object.

methods.name: setStrategy
methods.description: Sets the CSRF defense strategy object.
